title: Round 172 (F478): Item save file - path = '.\\Data\\' (0x47BDC4) + char-name + '.itm' (0x47BDCC) via 0x45DC70 (0x8AB7A8); manager 0x42DC20 builds file from player name; record ctor 0x415730 wraps item 0x430920 at +0xC (bag slot records = 0xC + 0xC20 = 0xC2C stride, F293 confirmed); 0x415760 = bag manager ctor (0x47663C vtable, 46 x 0xC2C records [0x5B8], 3 x 0xB4 controls [0x7C], 0x18 dwords [0x12A24]) - item persistence = per-character .itm file in Data
objective: Decode the item save file path/format and the bag manager structure.
question: Where and how are items persisted?

contrast.client_vs_server: client persists .itm locally (offline items); server = DB (F450)

verdict: Item save file PRIMARY-verified: Data/<name>.itm (0x47BDC4/0x47BDCC), record = 0xC header + 0xC20 item (0xC2C stride), bag manager 0x415760 (46 records + 3 controls). Persistence format closed.
notes: bag ctor 0x415760 distinct from manager 0x42DC20 (window vs persistence)
0x4175F0 = control ctor (3 controls in bag window)
